# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Jul 27, 2026)

## OVERVIEW

Today's development focused on enabling Super Root Games migration by default, fixing a CI build issue, and significant documentation improvements. Several critical issues related to op-node and op-reth stability were also resolved.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Core Protocol Enhancements & Stability
The `SUPER_ROOT_GAMES_MIGRATION` feature has been enabled by default in Foundry test configurations, marking a step forward in the protocol's evolution. This change ensures that the contracts feature matrix now includes an explicit opt-out row, while Go/Solidity bitmap predicates remain unchanged ([#21689](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21689)). Additionally, a critical fix was implemented in `op-node` to reject stale sequencer build starts, resolving a flaky test related to `TestSupernodeLightSequencerInteropInvalidMessageReplacement` ([#21913](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21913)). The `op-supernode` now also fails startup if the deny list cannot be opened, improving robustness ([#21997](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21997)).

### RPC and Deployment Tooling Improvements
`op-reth` now forwards `eth_getBlockReceipts` to its historical endpoint, enhancing RPC functionality ([#21955](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21955)). The `op-reth` runtime base has been pinned by digest, and `strace` was removed, streamlining the build process ([#22045](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22045)). Stale TODO references related to issue #20912 were removed from `op-deployer`, and `OPContractsManagerV2` was bumped, though without behavioral or ABI changes ([#22044](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22044)).

### Documentation and CI Pipeline Refinements
Significant updates were made to the public documentation, including single-sourcing governance treasury addresses ([#22008](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22008)), adding a "Get Started" home tab as the primary landing experience ([#22024](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22024)), archiving five stale notice pages ([#22050](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22050)), and renaming the "OP Stack" tab to "Protocol" while re-homing "Contribute" under "Get Started" ([#22038](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22038)). A CI fix addressed an `apko` factory pin issue to include `cargo-profile` input ([#22046](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22046)), and the CI now allows uppercase letters in PR title scopes ([#22035](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22035)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS

A total of 14 new pull requests were opened today, covering a range of topics:
- **`op-reth` Enhancements:** Several PRs focus on `op-reth`, including bounding validator resync/reorg waits in proofs e2e tests ([#22056](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22056)), making forwarded `txpool` admission opt-in ([#22053](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22053)), and exporting `OpLocalPayloadAttributesBuilder` ([#22043](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22043)).
- **`op-devstack` Improvements:** New PRs aim to improve `op-devstack` by waiting for the destination chain before sending executing messages ([#22055](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22055)) and using mutual trusted EL peering to survive peer drops ([#22052](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22052)).
- **CI/CD Optimizations:** Multiple PRs target CI/CD, such as bumping `github.com/quic-go/webtransport-go` ([#22049](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22049)), bumping factory pins to the latest main ([#22047](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22047)), and various Rust CI optimizations including fast linker, split builds, and sccache testing ([#22042](https://github.com/ethereum.optimism/optimism/pull/22042), [#22041](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22041), [#22040](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22040), [#22039](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22039)).
- **Other:** A cherry-pick to activate Karst at genesis by default in `op-deployer` ([#22048](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22048)), a documentation update for application-facing OP Enterprise callouts ([#22037](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22037)), and a `op-supernode` change to rewind interop accepted state on L2 safe head reorgs ([#22036](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22036)).

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Deployment and Configuration Issues Resolved
The issue concerning the addition of starting anchor root and prestate hashes to the deploy input ([#20912](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20912)) has been closed. This issue tracked the need for `op-deployer` to expose `startingAnchorRoot` and per-game-type prestate hashes, which are already accepted by `OPContractsManager`'s `FullConfig` struct. The closure follows the removal of stale TODO references in the codebase.

### RPC Functionality Fixed
The missing `eth_getBlockReceipts` from the list of forwarded RPCs for the historical endpoint in `op-reth` ([#21031](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21031)) has been addressed and closed. This ensures that `eth_getBlockReceipts` is now correctly handled by the historical RPC endpoint.

### Flaky Test Stability Achieved
The flaky test `TestSupernodeLightSequencerInteropInvalidMessageReplacement` ([#21635](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21635)) has been resolved and closed. The root cause was identified as `FollowSource` canonicalizing upstream block N+1 while the active light sequencer still had a timer armed against N, leading to stale build starts. The fix involves rejecting non-derived build starts unless their parent block ID matches the engine controller's current unsafe block ID.

## NEW ISSUES

### Proposer Configuration
A new issue has been opened to read the Dispute Game Factory (DGF) address from the superchain registry for standard networks, rather than requiring it as an input ([#22051](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22051)). This aims to auto-configure the proposer using a `--network` flag, similar to `op-proposer`.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### PreimageOracle Gas Reservation for Glamsterdam
Discussion continues on increasing `PreimageOracle.PRECOMPILE_CALL_RESERVED_GAS` before Glamsterdam (EIP-8037) ([#19380](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19380)). The latest comment suggests that the issue might be stale as written, as `PRECOMPILE_CALL_RESERVED_GAS` is for precompile call setup, not guaranteeing whole-function completion. The current EIP-8037/8038 drafts indicate that the proposed `200_000` value would be insufficient for a stronger whole-function invariant, potentially requiring `400_000`. The recommendation is to either close the issue as unnecessary for correctness (while adding Amsterdam gas-estimation/regression coverage) or rewrite it to explicitly guarantee whole-function success at the guard threshold with an updated value.

### `TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_CLSync` Flakiness
The `TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_CLSync` family of tests continues to experience flakiness ([#21041](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21041)). A recent occurrence on July 27th showed a total EL-backfill stall, where the follower `op-reth` needed to backfill blocks but its only EL peer (the sequencer's `op-reth`) disconnected at the exact moment backfill started and never re-established. This suggests an EL peer-management defect rather than a test budget issue. Previous investigations had ruled out test budget as the root cause, pointing to an `op-reth` Engine API stall. The current observation of a peer drop at pipeline start with no re-dial warrants further investigation into EL peer management.
